# Ebda Store (ابدأ ستور) — full capability list

> Ebda Store — ابدأ ستور, by Ebda AI Studio (ebda.app). A self-serve online store builder for sellers in Egypt, Arabic-first with English. Not to be confused with any other site named Ebda. Generated from the same source as https://ebda.app/en/features/ and /en/compare/*; short version: https://ebda.app/llms.txt

Pricing (EGP per month): Basic 1,490, Growth 3,490, Business 9,990; yearly billing saves 25%; 14-day free Growth trial; 0% commission on every plan. Sign up: https://store.ebda.app/signup

## AI inside everything, not a button on the side.
Ebda Store works alongside you in your store, search, accounts, stock and numbers. You decide, and the AI prepares the work.

### Your store gets written with you
- Press a button and it writes the product description in Arabic and English, and you review and publish.
- Translate products between Arabic and English in one click.
- Search-engine titles and descriptions, FAQs, categories, tags and image alt text, for one product or your whole store.

### Search that understands your shoppers
- Every product gets its own search words in Egyptian Arabic, Franco and English, and you can edit them.
- A shopper types "gazma" or "كوتشي" and still finds the product.
- Search by meaning: shoppers type what they have in mind and search understands what they mean. (coming soon)

### Your books close faster
- Snap a photo of a supplier receipt and upload it, and it becomes a draft expense for you to review. (Growth and Business plans)
- Alerts when your margin drops, costs jump, revenue falls or refunds rise, explained in Arabic and English.

### Your stock tells you what to do
- Reorder suggestions: it works out how fast each product sells and tells you when to reorder and how much, with the reason.
- Slow-moving products are flagged on their own, with ready-made clearance copy.
- An email warns you when a product is about to run out. (Growth and Business plans)

### Your numbers explain themselves
- Two lines in Arabic and English above your numbers explain what changed.
- See what shoppers searched for, and what they searched for and found nothing.
- Products that sell together show up for shoppers on the product page and in the cart.

### Your AI assistant runs the store
- Ask your assistant to add products, change prices and review orders instead of opening the dashboard. (Growth and Business plans)
- The InstaPay receipt a customer uploads is read automatically, so nobody types the transfer details.
- Your store shows up for AI assistants: an llms file and a product feed they can read.

## Capabilities
### Templates, ready-made looks and a page builder
Pick from five templates with three ready-made looks each, then change colours, photos and the order of sections in a page builder where you see every change as you make it. No developer needed.
Arabic: قوالب وأشكال جاهزة ومحرر صفحات

### A free address and your own domain
Every store gets a free yourname.ebda.app address, and you can connect your own domain from the dashboard. A custom domain is available on every plan.
Arabic: لينك مجاني ودومين خاص بيك

### AI that writes, translates and optimises
It writes product descriptions and translates them between Arabic and English, suggests search words, categories, tags and image alt text, and drafts search-engine titles, descriptions and FAQs. You review and publish. Available on: Included in the paid plans, within fair-use limits.
Arabic: الذكاء الاصطناعي بيكتب ويترجم ويحسّن

### Smart search that understands Egyptian Arabic and Franco
Your shoppers type the way they talk: in Egyptian Arabic, in Franco like "gazma" or "kotshy", or in English. Search understands letter variants such as أ/ا and ه/ة, and still finds the product when the spelling is not exact.
Arabic: بحث ذكي بيفهم المصري والفرانكو

### AI search words for every product
Every product gets its own search words in Egyptian Arabic, Franco and English, plus the common misspellings, without you typing them. You can edit or add to them at any time.
Arabic: كلمات بحث بالذكاء الاصطناعي لكل منتج

### Search by meaning
Status: coming soon, not live yet.
Shoppers type what they have in mind, not the exact product name, and search understands what they mean. We are rolling it out gradually, and it only switches on for your store once its results pass our quality check on a real catalogue.
Arabic: بحث بالمعنى

### See what your shoppers search for
See what shoppers searched for, and what they searched for and found nothing, so you can add the missing product or tune the search words.
Arabic: اعرف عملاءك بيدوّروا على إيه

### SEO and visibility in AI answers
Search-engine titles and descriptions, redirects for old links, structured FAQs, an llms.txt file for your store and a product feed that AI assistants can read. You can also track whether AI assistants mention your store.
Arabic: SEO وظهور في إجابات الذكاء الاصطناعي

### Run your store from an AI assistant
Connect your favourite assistant to your store and ask it to add products, change prices and review orders instead of opening the dashboard. Available on: Growth and Business plans.
Arabic: شغّل متجرك من مساعد ذكاء اصطناعي

### Abandoned-cart recovery
When a shopper leaves items in the cart, the store reminds them in steps and sends them back to the cart with a direct link, by notification or by SMS when the shopper agreed to receive it. Available on: Growth and Business plans.
Arabic: استرجاع السلات المتروكة

### Cart reminder emails
Status: coming soon, not live yet.
Shoppers opt in to a reminder at checkout, guests included, and if they leave the cart an email brings them straight back to it. Available on: Part of abandoned-cart recovery.
Arabic: تذكير السلة المتروكة بالإيميل

### Order emails that send themselves
Order confirmation, shipping, refunds, payment success or failure and a review request after delivery all go to your customer in Arabic or English, styled to match your store.
Arabic: إيميلات الطلبات بتتبعت لوحدها

### Email campaigns to your subscribers
Status: coming soon, not live yet.
Write a marketing email in Arabic and English and send it to newsletter subscribers who agreed to receive it. Available on: Growth and Business plans.
Arabic: حملات إيميل لمشتركيك

### Connect your store to your other tools
Status: coming soon, not live yet.
When something happens in your store, such as a new order, it notifies the tool you choose, so you can connect it to your accounting, shipping or any other tool you work with. Available on: Growth and Business plans.
Arabic: اربط متجرك بأدواتك التانية

### Loyalty points, referral rewards and affiliates
Customers earn points on every pound they spend and for signing up, reviewing, birthdays and referrals, and move up through four tiers. Larger stores can also run an affiliate programme with a commission you set. Available on: Points on Growth and Business, affiliate programme on Business.
Arabic: نقاط ولاء ومكافآت إحالة وعمولة مسوّقين

### Customer reviews
Customers review a product after it arrives, and you moderate reviews before they appear on your store.
Arabic: تقييمات العملاء

### Store analytics
See what sells and your revenue. The level of detail grows with the plan.
Arabic: تحليلات متجرك

### Multiple warehouses and purchase orders
If you keep stock in more than one place, track inventory per warehouse, raise purchase orders to suppliers and scan product barcodes. Available on: Business plan.
Arabic: أكتر من مخزن وأوامر شراء

### Order barcodes and a packing slip
Status: coming soon, not live yet.
Every order has a barcode you scan to open it straight away, in 23 fun shapes. A packing slip carries the barcode, and you can print slips in bulk.
Arabic: باركود للطلبات وبوليصة تغليف

### Wholesale selling (B2B)
Status: coming soon, not live yet.
Prices that drop as quantity grows, customer groups, minimum orders, and your approval of a wholesale buyer before they can order. Available on: Business plan.
Arabic: بيع بالجملة (B2B)

### Payments and shipping the Egyptian market expects
Cash on delivery, InstaPay, and card and wallet payments through Paymob, Kashier and FawryPay. Shipping with Bosta, ShipBlu, Mylerz and Aramex, or deliver yourself.
Arabic: دفع وشحن زي ما السوق المصري متعود

### 0% commission on your orders
You pay the subscription only, with no commission on any order on any plan. Payment gateway fees are separate when a customer pays online.
Arabic: صفر عمولة على طلباتك

## And also
- Coupons and promotions, which can target customer groups
- Returns handled from the dashboard
- Team accounts with roles
- Bulk product import from CSV or Excel
- Server-side Meta and TikTok ad conversion tracking
- 3D product models and AR on every plan
- A dashboard you install on your phone that notifies you of every order

## FAQ
Q: Does Ebda Store have templates and ready-made designs?
A: Yes. There are five templates with three ready-made looks each, and you can change colours, photos and sections in the page builder.

Q: Can I connect my own domain?
A: Yes, on every plan. If you would rather wait, your store runs on a free yourname.ebda.app address.

Q: Does search understand Egyptian Arabic and Franco?
A: Yes. A shopper can type "gazma", "كوتشي" or English, search understands letter variants, and every product gets AI search words that you can edit.

Q: Is there search by meaning?
A: It is rolling out gradually and coming soon. We will not switch it on for your store until its results pass our quality check on a real catalogue.

Q: Does it recover abandoned carts?
A: Yes, on the Growth and Business plans. The store reminds shoppers in steps by notification, and by SMS when they agreed to it. Reminder emails are coming soon.

Q: Is there loyalty and a referral programme?
A: Yes. Loyalty points, tiers and referral rewards are on Growth and Business, and the affiliate programme with commission is on Business.

Q: Can I send email campaigns to newsletter subscribers?
A: Automatic order emails (confirmation, shipping, refunds, review request) work on every plan. Email campaigns to subscribers are coming soon on Growth and Business.

Q: Can I connect my store to other tools?
A: This is coming soon on Growth and Business. There is no app marketplace, but you will be able to connect your store to your tools.

Q: Are there order barcodes?
A: Coming soon: a barcode on every order in 23 fun shapes, and a packing slip that carries it, with bulk printing.

Q: Can I sell wholesale to businesses?
A: Coming soon on the Business plan: prices that drop with quantity, customer groups, minimum orders, and your approval of a wholesale buyer. Until it ships there are no wholesale price lists.

Q: Is AI included in the price?
A: Yes. The AI tools are included in the paid plans, within fair-use limits, with no separate subscription.

Q: Is there a commission on orders?
A: No. It is 0% on every plan. You pay the subscription, and the payment gateway charges its own fee when a customer pays online.

Q: What is not there yet?
A: There is no app marketplace, no custom code editor, no point-of-sale and no multi-currency store. The comparison pages for Salla, Zid and Shopify go through the details, and what is coming soon.

## Comparisons (as of October 2026)
Competitor facts are general and publicly known; check their sites before deciding.

### Ebda Store vs Salla — https://ebda.app/en/compare/salla/
Both Ebda Store and Salla let you open an online store in Arabic. The difference is that Ebda Store is built for Egypt, while Salla started in Saudi Arabia. This page says where each is stronger, including what Ebda Store does not have yet.
- Home market: Ebda Store — Egypt first: Egyptian pounds, InstaPay and Egyptian carriers. Salla — Salla started in Saudi Arabia.
- Subscription currency: Ebda Store — In pounds: EGP 1,490, 3,490 and 9,990 a month. Salla — Check Salla's site for current pricing and billing currency.
- Commission on orders: Ebda Store — 0% on every order on every plan. Payment gateway fees are separate. Salla — Check Salla's current plan terms. Payment gateway fees apply on any platform.
- Arabic: Ebda Store — Store and dashboard are Arabic-first, with Egyptian Arabic copy. Salla — Salla is Arabic-first.
- Egyptian and Franco search: Ebda Store — Search understands Egyptian Arabic, Franco, English and letter variants, and every product gets AI search words you can edit. Salla — Check Salla's site for its current search features.
- Search insights: Ebda Store — See what shoppers searched for, and what they searched for and found nothing. Salla — Check Salla's site for its search reports.
- AI tools: Ebda Store — Descriptions, translation, SEO and search words, plus receipt-to-expense drafts, reorder suggestions and plain-language explanations of your numbers, included in the paid plans. Salla — Check Salla's site for its AI features and which plan includes them.
- Payments and shipping in Egypt: Ebda Store — Cash on delivery, InstaPay, Paymob, Kashier, FawryPay, and shipping with Bosta, ShipBlu, Mylerz and Aramex. Salla — Check which Egyptian gateways and carriers Salla supports for your account.
- Templates and design: Ebda Store — Five templates with three looks each, and a page builder. Salla — Check Salla's site for its themes and editor.
- Cart recovery and loyalty: Ebda Store — Abandoned-cart recovery by notification or SMS, and loyalty points, from the Growth plan. Salla — Check Salla's site for cart recovery and loyalty options.
- Search by meaning: Ebda Store — Coming soon: rolling out gradually, and only switched on for your store once its results pass our quality check on a real catalogue. Salla — Check Salla's site for how its search handles meaning.
- Connecting other tools (webhooks): Ebda Store — Coming soon on Growth and Business: the store will notify the tool you choose when something happens, such as a new order. Salla — Check Salla's site for webhooks and integrations.
- App marketplace: Ebda Store — There is no app marketplace. Salla — Check Salla's site for its app store.
- Custom code: Ebda Store — You edit in the page builder without code, and there is no custom code editor. Salla — Check Salla's site for developer and theme customisation tools.
- Wholesale (B2B) pricing: Ebda Store — Coming soon on the Business plan: quantity price breaks, customer groups, minimum orders and wholesale-buyer approval. Until it ships there are no wholesale price lists. Salla — Check Salla's site for wholesale pricing.
- Point of sale (POS): Ebda Store — There is no in-store point of sale. Salla — Check Salla's site for in-store selling options.
- Multiple currencies: Ebda Store — The store sells in Egyptian pounds only. Salla — Check Salla's site for multi-currency support.
- Marketing email campaigns: Ebda Store — Coming soon on Growth and Business. Order emails work today on every plan. Salla — Check Salla's site for email marketing options.
- Size of platform and community: Ebda Store — A newer platform, so fewer integrations and a smaller community. Salla — Check Salla's site for its merchant base and partners.

### Ebda Store vs Shopify — https://ebda.app/en/compare/shopify/
Shopify is a large global platform serving merchants in many countries, while Ebda Store is built for Egypt only. This page says where each is stronger, including what Ebda Store does not have yet.
- Home market: Ebda Store — Egypt first: Egyptian pounds, InstaPay and Egyptian carriers. Shopify — Global, with merchants in many countries.
- Subscription currency: Ebda Store — In pounds: EGP 1,490, 3,490 and 9,990 a month. Shopify — Check Shopify's site for the billing currency in Egypt.
- Commission on orders: Ebda Store — 0% on every order on every plan. Payment gateway fees are separate. Shopify — A transaction fee applies on orders paid through third-party gateways unless you use Shopify Payments. Check whether it is available for Egypt.
- Arabic: Ebda Store — Store and dashboard are Arabic-first, with Egyptian Arabic copy. Shopify — Arabic and right-to-left are supported, mainly through themes and apps.
- Egyptian and Franco search: Ebda Store — Search understands Egyptian Arabic, Franco, English and letter variants, and every product gets AI search words you can edit. Shopify — Compare the current search features and apps.
- Search insights: Ebda Store — See what shoppers searched for, and what they searched for and found nothing. Shopify — Search reports are available; compare the detail.
- AI tools: Ebda Store — Descriptions, translation, SEO and search words, plus receipt-to-expense drafts, reorder suggestions and plain-language explanations of your numbers, included in the paid plans. Shopify — Has AI features. Compare the current scope and which plan includes them.
- Payments and shipping in Egypt: Ebda Store — Cash on delivery, InstaPay, Paymob, Kashier, FawryPay, and shipping with Bosta, ShipBlu, Mylerz and Aramex. Shopify — Egyptian gateways and carriers depend on apps and integrations. Check what is available.
- Templates and design: Ebda Store — Five templates with three looks each, and a page builder. Shopify — A very large theme store and a theme editor.
- Cart recovery and loyalty: Ebda Store — Abandoned-cart recovery by notification or SMS, and loyalty points, from the Growth plan. Shopify — Available, built in or through apps.
- Search by meaning: Ebda Store — Coming soon: rolling out gradually, and only switched on for your store once its results pass our quality check on a real catalogue. Shopify — Check Shopify's site for how its search handles meaning.
- Connecting other tools (webhooks): Ebda Store — Coming soon on Growth and Business: the store will notify the tool you choose when something happens, such as a new order. Shopify — Webhooks and a developer API are available, alongside the app store.
- App marketplace: Ebda Store — There is no app marketplace. Shopify — A very large app store.
- Custom code: Ebda Store — You edit in the page builder without code, and there is no custom code editor. Shopify — A theme code editor and developer tools.
- Wholesale (B2B) pricing: Ebda Store — Coming soon on the Business plan: quantity price breaks, customer groups, minimum orders and wholesale-buyer approval. Until it ships there are no wholesale price lists. Shopify — Check Shopify's site for B2B features and which plans include them.
- Point of sale (POS): Ebda Store — There is no in-store point of sale. Shopify — Shopify POS for physical shops.
- Multiple currencies: Ebda Store — The store sells in Egyptian pounds only. Shopify — Selling in multiple currencies and countries.
- Marketing email campaigns: Ebda Store — Coming soon on Growth and Business. Order emails work today on every plan. Shopify — Email marketing through built-in tools or apps.
- Size of platform and community: Ebda Store — A newer platform, so fewer integrations and a smaller community. Shopify — An established platform with a very large merchant base and partner ecosystem.
